scenario: 邮箱有几十万封邮件，搜索匹配到数千封，要把它们批量移动到 newsletter 文件夹。
scenario_en: A mailbox has hundreds of thousands of emails; a search matches several thousand, which must be bulk-moved to the newsletter folder.
q: 这个批量移动 API 该做成同步还是异步？
q_en: Should this bulk-move API be synchronous or asynchronous?
options: 异步：立刻返回 job_id + queued，后台慢慢移动
同步：请求里一次性把几千封邮件都移完再返回
让前端一封一封地串行调用移动接口
不用后端，直接在浏览器里改所有邮件
options_en: Asynchronous: return a job_id + queued immediately and move in the background
Synchronous: move all several-thousand emails within the request before returning
Have the frontend call a move endpoint one email at a time, serially
Skip the backend and change all emails in the browser
optionExplanations: 对：几千封的活儿放后台，API 秒回 job_id，用户不被阻塞、也不会请求超时。
错：同步移几千封会长时间阻塞、极易超时，是坏设计。
错：前端串行调几千次又慢又脆，一断就残缺。
错：移动是服务端数据操作，浏览器改不了、也不安全。
optionExplanations_en: Right: push the several-thousand moves to the background and return a job_id instantly, so the user is not blocked and the request cannot time out.
Wrong: moving thousands synchronously blocks for a long time and easily times out — a bad design.
Wrong: thousands of serial frontend calls are slow and fragile; one drop leaves it half-done.
Wrong: moving is a server-side data operation; the browser cannot and should not do it.
why: 数千封的批量操作要异步：POST 立刻入队并返回 job_id + status=queued，真正的移动在后台 worker 里做。同步会长时间阻塞、请求超时。
why_en: A several-thousand-item bulk op must be async: the POST enqueues and returns a job_id + status=queued instantly, while the real moving happens in background workers. Synchronous would block and time out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求只负责「登记任务 + 立刻返回 job_id」，实际耗时工作交给后台 worker 慢慢做，客户端事后查进度
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An async job means the request just records the task and returns a job_id immediately; the heavy work runs in background workers and the client polls progress later.

scenario: 为批量移动设计一组 REST 接口：发起、查进度、拉明细。
scenario_en: Design a REST API set for bulk move: kick off, check progress, list details.
q: 这组批量移动接口的合理形态是？
q_en: What is a reasonable shape for this bulk-move API?
options: POST 发起(带 search token+目标文件夹)→{job_id,queued}；GET 查 job 进度；GET job/items 分页拉明细
只用一个同步 POST，一次返回全部移动结果
用 GET 发起移动、把邮件 ID 全塞进 URL 查询串
每封邮件一个独立 endpoint，前端自己拼
options_en: POST to start (search token + destination folder) → {job_id, queued}; GET job progress; GET job/items paginated details
A single synchronous POST that returns all move results at once
Use GET to start the move and stuff all email ids into the query string
One endpoint per email, assembled by the frontend
optionExplanations: 对：一个 POST 发起(返回 job_id)、一个 GET 查进度、一个 GET 分页拉明细——异步三件套。
错：同步返回全部结果就退回阻塞式设计了。
错：GET 不该有副作用，URL 也塞不下几千个 ID。
错：一封一个 endpoint 违背批量的初衷。
optionExplanations_en: Right: one POST to start (returns job_id), one GET for progress, one GET for paginated details — the async trio.
Wrong: returning all results synchronously falls back to the blocking design.
Wrong: GET should be side-effect-free, and a URL cannot hold thousands of ids.
Wrong: one endpoint per email defeats the point of a bulk op.
why: 异步 API 三件套：POST 发起→立刻回 job_id+queued；GET job 查进度(total/processed/success/fail)；GET job/items 分页拉每封的结果。发起用 POST(有副作用)，查询用 GET。
why_en: The async trio: POST to start → job_id + queued instantly; GET job for progress (total/processed/success/fail); GET job/items paginated for per-message results. Start with POST (side effects), read with GET.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表「那批搜索结果」的引用/句柄（不是加密串）：请求只带这个短 token，服务端拿它去查出对应的几千个 message id（从结果表/缓存/重跑查询）。作用是「少传一堆 id + 引用服务端的集合」，不是保密；服务端是「查找」不是「解密」
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reference/handle to the search result set (not an encrypted blob): the request carries this short token and the server looks up the thousands of message ids it points to (from a store/cache/re-run). It is about indirection (avoid sending many ids), not secrecy; the server dereferences it, not decrypts it.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 状态码：请求已受理但还没处理完——异步作业发起后的标准返回
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 202 Accepted: the request was accepted but not yet completed — the standard return for kicking off an async job.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两码事：「谁在操作」由请求头里的鉴权 token(session/JWT)决定、不放 body(放 body 客户端能伪造)；search_result_token 只回答「移哪些邮件」(那批搜索结果)。别拿 user id 当 body token
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two separate things: WHO is acting comes from the auth token in the header (session/JWT), never the body (spoofable); search_result_token only says WHICH emails to move. Do not put a user id as a body token.

termDefinitions.meaning: processed_count=已处理(试过)的条数 = success + fail；success_count=其中成功的；fail_count=失败的。processed 看「进度」(和 total 比判完成)，success/fail 看「结果」
termDefinitions.meaningEn: processed_count = tasks attempted (= success + fail); success_count = those that succeeded; fail_count = those that failed. processed tracks progress (vs total for completion); success/fail track the outcome.

scenario: 批量移动请求刚打到服务端，还没开始建作业。
scenario_en: The bulk-move request just hit the server, before any job is created.
q: 服务端收到请求后，第一件该做的事是什么？
q_en: What is the first thing the server should do on receiving the request?
options: 鉴权：确认这个用户有权移动这些邮件、访问目标文件夹
立刻把几千封邮件全部移动完
先给前端发一封确认邮件
先重建整个搜索索引
options_en: Authorize: verify this user may move these emails and access the destination folder
Immediately move all several-thousand emails
First send the frontend a confirmation email
First rebuild the entire search index
optionExplanations: 对：先鉴权(authn/authz)——用户是谁、有没有权限动这些邮件和目标文件夹，否则是越权漏洞。
错：还没鉴权就动数据，且移动本身要走异步作业。
错：确认邮件不是移动流程该做的事。
错：搜索已给定，不需要在移动前重建索引。
optionExplanations_en: Right: authorize first — who the user is and whether they may touch these emails and the destination folder; otherwise it is a privilege-escalation hole.
Wrong: touching data before authorizing, and the move itself must go async.
Wrong: a confirmation email is not part of the move flow.
Wrong: search is given; no need to rebuild the index before moving.
why: 第一步是鉴权(authentication + authorization)：确认用户身份，并检查他有权移动这些邮件、写入目标文件夹。跳过这步就是越权/数据泄漏漏洞。这也是面试官特意问的点。
why_en: The first step is auth (authentication + authorization): confirm the user and check they may move these emails and write to the destination folder. Skipping it is a privilege-escalation hole — a point the interviewer specifically probed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 鉴权：确认「已登录的这个用户，有没有权限做这个操作/访问这些资源」；区别于 authn(确认你是谁)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Authorization checks whether the authenticated user is allowed to perform this action / access these resources — distinct from authentication (who you are).

scenario: 邮箱几十万封邮件，搜索匹配到数千封要批量移到某文件夹；画出支撑这个异步批量移动的服务端架构。
scenario_en: A mailbox has hundreds of thousands of emails; a search matches several thousand to bulk-move into a folder — sketch the server architecture for this async bulk move.
q: 哪条链路是这题的合理架构？
q_en: Which is a reasonable architecture for this problem?
options: API 网关→bulk-move 服务(建 job+入队)→队列→worker 池并行移动、逐条回写状态
API 网关→bulk-move 服务→在这一次请求里同步循环把几千封全部移完再返回
API 网关→服务→把几千封打包成一条巨型队列消息→交给单个 worker 全做完
客户端直连数据库、逐条发 SQL 修改→绕过网关和服务层、也不用队列
options_en: API gateway → bulk-move service (create job + enqueue) → queue → worker pool moving in parallel, writing status back
API gateway → bulk-move service → synchronously loop and move all several-thousand within this one request
API gateway → service → pack all several-thousand into one giant queue message handled by a single worker
The client issues SQL row-by-row directly to the DB, bypassing the gateway/service and using no queue
optionExplanations: 对:网关→服务(建 job+入队)→队列→worker 池并行、逐条回写——异步、可水平扩、失败可重试。
错:同步循环几千封会长时间阻塞、请求超时,退回阻塞设计。
错:巨型单消息+单 worker=单点、无并行、失败全丢。
错:客户端直连库、绕过服务层是安全与耦合灾难。
optionExplanations_en: Right: gateway → service (create job + enqueue) → queue → worker pool in parallel, writing status back — async, scalable, retryable.
Wrong: a synchronous loop over thousands blocks and times out — the blocking design again.
Wrong: one giant message + a single worker is a single point, no parallelism, all-or-nothing failure.
Wrong: a client connecting directly to the DB and bypassing the service is a security and coupling disaster.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  C["client"] --> G["API Gateway"] --> S["bulk-move 服务"]
  S -->|建作业| DB[("job DB\njobs / message / task")]
  S -->|每封一个任务入队| Q["队列"]
  Q --> W["worker 池"]
  W -->|移动 + 更新状态| DB
why: 标准异步批处理架构：client→API 网关→bulk-move 服务，服务把 job 写进库、并把每封邮件的移动任务丢进队列；下游 worker 池并行消费、逐条移动并回写状态。异步、可水平扩、失败可重试。
why_en: A standard async batch architecture: client → API gateway → bulk-move service, which writes the job to the DB and enqueues a move task per email; a downstream worker pool consumes in parallel, moves one by one, and writes back status. Async, horizontally scalable, retryable.

scenario: 批量移动要知道「移哪些邮件」。搜索已由别的服务给出。
scenario_en: Bulk move needs to know which emails to move; search is provided by another service.
q: 「移哪些」用存好的结果集，还是存查询重跑？
q_en: Should "which emails" come from a stored result set or from re-running a stored query?
options: 两种都行：存 search_result_token(结果集快照)，或存查询条件、发起时在服务端重跑
只能把几千个 message id 全部塞进请求体
必须让用户在前端把每封邮件都勾一遍再传上来
直接移动全邮箱，不用管搜索结果
options_en: Either works: store a search_result_token (a snapshot of the set), or store the query and re-run it server-side on kickoff
You must stuff all several-thousand message ids into the request body
The user must tick every email in the frontend and upload them
Just move the whole mailbox and ignore the search result
optionExplanations: 对：token=结果快照(稳定、不随邮箱变)；重跑查询=省存储但结果可能已变。看要不要「所见即所得」。
错：几千个 id 塞请求体又大又脆。
错：手动勾几千封不现实。
错：移全邮箱不是用户要的。
optionExplanations_en: Right: a token is a snapshot (stable, unaffected by mailbox changes); re-running the query saves storage but the set may have changed. Depends on whether you need what-you-saw-is-what-you-get.
Wrong: thousands of ids in the body are bulky and fragile.
Wrong: ticking thousands by hand is unrealistic.
Wrong: moving the whole mailbox is not what the user asked.
why: 两条路：①存 search_result_token——搜索结果的快照，稳定(移动时仍是当初看到的那批)、但要存；②只存查询条件，发起时在服务端重跑——省存储，但邮箱变了结果可能不同。取舍=一致性快照 vs 存储成本。
why_en: Two options: (1) store a search_result_token — a snapshot of the results, stable (you move exactly what you saw) but needs storage; (2) store the query and re-run it server-side on kickoff — cheaper, but the set may differ if the mailbox changed. Trade-off: consistent snapshot vs storage cost.
tradeoff: 存结果集快照(稳定·占存储) vs 存查询重跑(省存储·结果可能变)

scenario: message 表只存每封邮件「当前在哪个文件夹」。
scenario_en: The message table only stores each email's current folder.
q: 为什么还要一张 task 表（每次移动一条记录）？
q_en: Why also keep a task table (one row per move)?
options: 做审计/历史：message 表只有当前快照，task 表能重建「这封为什么到了这个文件夹」
因为 message 表存不下 message_id
为了让搜索更快
因为队列必须有一张同名表
options_en: For audit/history: the message table is only the current snapshot; the task table reconstructs why an email ended up in a folder
Because the message table cannot store message_id
To make search faster
Because the queue requires a same-named table
optionExplanations: 对：message 表=当前状态，看不出历史；task 表逐条记录每次移动(源→目标)，可回溯审计。
错：message 表当然存得下 message_id。
错：task 表跟搜索性能无关。
错：队列不要求这张表。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the message table is current state with no history; the task table records each move (source → destination) for auditability.
Wrong: the message table can of course store message_id.
Wrong: the task table is unrelated to search speed.
Wrong: the queue does not require this table.
why: message 表只有「当前在哪个文件夹」的快照，看不出历史。task 表每次移动记一条(message_id、源文件夹、目标文件夹、job_id、status、时间)，用于审计——事后能回答「这封邮件为什么在这个文件夹」。
why_en: The message table holds only a current-folder snapshot with no history. The task table records each move (message_id, source folder, destination folder, job_id, status, time) for audit — so you can later answer "why is this email in this folder".

termDefinitions.meaning: 只记录「发生过什么」的追加表；主表存当前状态，审计表存变更历史，用于回溯与合规
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An append-only table recording what happened; the main table holds current state while the audit table holds change history for traceability and compliance.

termDefinitions.term: job 表 vs task 表
termDefinitions.meaning: 两张表、两种粒度：job 表=1 行汇总(total/processed/success/fail + 总状态)；task 表=N 行、每封一条执行记录(状态、源/目标、job_id)。job 的计数是 task 状态的「汇总缓存」，查进度不用扫全 task 表。这跟 job scheduler 的 job / run(execution) 两表是同一套
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two tables, two granularities: the job table is one summary row (total/processed/success/fail + overall status); the task table is N rows, one per-email execution (status, source/dest, job_id). The job counts are a denormalized cache of task statuses, so progress needs no full task scan — the same job/run(execution) split as a job scheduler.

termDefinitions.meaning: 移了 300/1000 中途停了 → 不新建 job、沿用原 job；task 表里每封的状态区分「已完成/未完成」，只重跑 status≠done 的 700 封。配合幂等 worker(已 done 就跳过)，重投也不会重复移动。这也是为什么必须有 task 表：没有每封状态就没法精确续跑
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Resume: if 300 of 1000 moved and it stopped, reuse the same job — the task table's per-email status separates done from not-done, so only the 700 not-done are re-run; idempotent workers skip already-done ones. This is why the task table is essential: without per-item status you cannot resume precisely.

termDefinitions.term: message 表 vs task 表
termDefinitions.meaning: message 表=邮件的「户口本」:一封邮件一行,存它「现在」在哪个文件夹(状态,移动时原地改)。task 表=移动的「流水账」:每移动一次记一行(从哪→到哪、状态、哪个 job),同一封邮件可能有多行(移过几次)。前者=当前状态,后者=操作历史
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The message table is the email ID card: one row per email holding its current folder (state, updated in place on a move). The task table is the move ledger: one row per move (source→dest, status, job), and one email can have many rows over time. State vs history of operations.

scenario: 面试官问：明天要支持批量删除、批量归档等其它批操作，task 表怎么改才通用？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: to also support bulk delete, archive, and other batch ops tomorrow, how should the task table generalize?
q: 怎么把 task 表从「只支持移动」泛化成「任意批操作」？
q_en: How do you generalize the task table from move-only to any batch op?
options: 加 task_type + task_payload：类型定义干什么，payload 放该操作的参数(如源/目标文件夹)
为每种操作各建一张全新的表
把操作类型硬编码进列名
删掉 task 表，改由前端记录操作
options_en: Add task_type + task_payload: the type says what to do, the payload holds that op's params (e.g. source/destination folder)
Create a brand-new table for every operation type
Hard-code the operation type into column names
Drop the task table and let the frontend record operations
optionExplanations: 对：把「移动专属」的源/目标字段收进通用的 task_payload，另加 task_type，一张表支持任意批操作。
错：每操作一张表会表爆炸、worker 也要各写一套。
错：把类型编进列名就是不可扩展的硬编码。
错：审计/执行状态必须在服务端，不能交前端。
optionExplanations_en: Right: fold the move-specific source/destination into a generic task_payload and add a task_type, so one table supports any batch op.
Wrong: a table per operation explodes tables and forces separate worker code.
Wrong: encoding the type into column names is unscalable hard-coding.
Wrong: audit/execution state must live server-side, not in the frontend.
why: 原 task 表有 source_folder_id/destination_folder_id，跟「移动」死绑。泛化：加 task_type(操作类型) + task_payload(该操作的参数)，移动就把源/目标放进 payload。这样批删除、批归档等复用同一张表和同一套 worker 框架。这是这题的 OOD 关键泛化点。
why_en: The original task table has source/destination folder ids, tightly bound to "move". Generalize by adding task_type (what op) + task_payload (that op's params); a move puts source/destination in the payload. Then bulk delete, archive, etc. reuse the same table and worker framework — the key OOD generalization here.
tradeoff: 移动专属字段(简单·不通用) vs task_type+payload(通用·多一层解释)

termDefinitions.meaning: 通用任务建模：一列存「操作类型」，一列(JSON)存该类型的具体参数——一张表/一套 worker 支持多种操作，加新操作只加 type 不改表
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Generic task modeling: one column for the operation type and one (JSON) for that type's params — one table/worker set supports many ops; a new op just adds a type, no schema change.

scenario: 一次匹配到 1 万封邮件要移动。
scenario_en: 10,000 emails match and must be moved in one job.
q: 队列 + worker 池怎么把这活干完？
q_en: How do the queue and worker pool get this done?
options: 每封邮件建一个任务入队；worker 池各自拉一条、执行移动、回写状态，天然并行+可重试
把 1 万封打包成一条巨型消息，一个 worker 一次做完
每个 worker 各扫全表找自己该做的邮件
不用队列，服务在请求里同步循环 1 万次
options_en: Enqueue one task per email; workers each pull one, do the move, write status back — naturally parallel and retryable
Pack all 10k into one giant message for a single worker to finish
Each worker scans the whole table to find its emails
No queue; the service loops 10k times synchronously in the request
optionExplanations: 对：一封一任务，worker 池并行消费，某条失败只重投那一条，不影响其余。
错：巨型单消息=单点、没并行、失败全丢。
错：各自扫全表既慢又会抢同一封。
错：同步循环 1 万次又回到阻塞设计。
optionExplanations_en: Right: one task per email, workers consume in parallel, and a failed one is redelivered alone without affecting the rest.
Wrong: one giant message is a single point, no parallelism, and one failure loses everything.
Wrong: scanning the whole table each is slow and workers fight over the same email.
Wrong: a synchronous 10k loop returns to the blocking design.
why: 生产者把每封邮件的移动做成一个任务入队(1 万封→1 万任务)；worker 池是消费者，每个 worker 拉一条、执行移动、更新该任务状态。粒度到单封→天然并行、单条失败可单独重试，互不影响。
why_en: The producer enqueues one move task per email (10k emails → 10k tasks); the worker pool are consumers, each pulling one, doing the move, and updating that task's status. Per-email granularity gives natural parallelism and lets a single failure retry alone without affecting others.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产者把任务丢进队列，消费者(worker 池)各自拉取处理；队列在中间削峰、解耦、支持重试
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A producer puts tasks on a queue and consumers (a worker pool) pull and process them; the queue in between smooths spikes, decouples, and enables retries.

scenario: worker 移动一封邮件：既要改它的所在文件夹，又要标这条任务已完成。
scenario_en: A worker moves one email: change its folder and mark the task done.
q: worker 该怎么保证这封邮件的移动不出现「半完成」？
q_en: How should the worker avoid a half-done move for one email?
options: 同一个事务里：改 message 的 current_folder_id + 把该 task 标为 finished，一起提交
先改文件夹，几秒后再单独去标任务，中间不管崩没崩
只标任务完成，别真去改文件夹
每封移动都锁全表，串行做
options_en: In one transaction: change the message current_folder_id AND mark the task finished, committed together
Change the folder, then separately mark the task seconds later, ignoring crashes in between
Only mark the task done without actually changing the folder
Lock the whole table for every move and do them serially
optionExplanations: 对：改文件夹和标任务放同一事务，要么都成、要么都回滚，不会出现「移了但没记」或反之。
错：两步分开，中间崩溃就状态不一致(半完成)。
错：不真移动就没意义。
错：锁全表串行毁掉并行、吞吐崩。
optionExplanations_en: Right: put the folder change and task mark in one transaction — both commit or both roll back, so you never get "moved but not recorded" or vice versa.
Wrong: two separate steps leave inconsistent (half-done) state if it crashes between them.
Wrong: not actually moving is pointless.
Wrong: locking the whole table serializes everything and kills throughput.
why: 移动一封 = 改它的 current_folder_id + 把这条 task 标 finished，两件事放在同一个数据库事务里一起提交：要么都成、要么都回滚，杜绝「改了文件夹但任务没记」的半完成。配合任务重试要幂等(已完成的重投就跳过)。
why_en: Moving one email = change its current_folder_id + mark the task finished, committed in one DB transaction: both succeed or both roll back, preventing a half-done "folder changed but task not recorded". Pair with idempotent retries (a redelivered already-done task is skipped).

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一任务执行一次或多次结果相同；这里靠「先查任务状态、已 finished 就跳过」保证重投无害
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means running a task once or many times has the same effect; here, checking task status and skipping if already finished makes redelivery harmless.

scenario: 面试官追问：谁把 job 的 status 标成 completed？总不能等 UI 轮询来标。
scenario_en: The interviewer probes: who marks the job status completed? You cannot rely on the UI polling to flip it.
q: job 完成状态该怎么判定和推送？
q_en: How should job completion be detected and delivered?
options: 服务端在 processed==total 时自己标 completed，并用 SSE/WebSocket 推给 UI
等 UI 每次轮询时顺便帮忙把 job 标成 completed
让每个 worker 都直接去改 job 的最终状态
永远靠前端每秒轮询数据库来判断
options_en: The server marks completed when processed==total, and pushes to the UI via SSE/WebSocket
Let the UI flip the job to completed whenever it happens to poll
Have every worker directly set the job's final status
Rely forever on the frontend polling the DB every second
optionExplanations: 对：worker 递增 processed/success/fail 计数，服务端在 processed==total 时判定并标 completed，再用 SSE/WebSocket 主动推 UI。
错：靠 UI 轮询来标状态，UI 不轮询就永远不完成——逻辑放错地方。
错：每个 worker 各改 job 终态会互相打架、判不准。
错：纯轮询浪费且延迟，push 更好。
optionExplanations_en: Right: workers increment processed/success/fail counts, the server decides completion when processed==total and marks it, then pushes to the UI via SSE/WebSocket.
Wrong: relying on the UI to flip status means it never completes if the UI stops polling — logic in the wrong place.
Wrong: every worker setting the final job status fights and mis-decides.
Wrong: pure polling wastes work and adds latency; push is better.
why: worker 每完成一条就原子递增 job 的 processed/success/fail；服务端(而不是 UI)在 processed==total 时判定完成、把 status 标 completed，再通过 SSE/WebSocket 主动通知 UI。别把「标完成」的责任放在前端轮询上。
why_en: Each finished task atomically increments the job's processed/success/fail counts; the server (not the UI) decides completion when processed==total, marks the status completed, and pushes it to the UI via SSE/WebSocket. Do not put the "mark complete" responsibility on frontend polling.
whenOtherWins: 若量很小、无实时性要求，简单轮询也能接受；但要「服务端权威判定完成」这点不变。

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端经一条长连接单向推送给客户端；作业完成时推一条通知，比前端反复轮询省且实时
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Server-Sent Events push updates server→client over one long-lived connection; pushing a completion event beats repeated frontend polling.

scenario: 面试官问：UI 想要一份「哪些成功、哪些失败」的报告，量还很大，甚至要 CSV/PDF。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: the UI wants a report of which succeeded/failed — large, possibly as CSV/PDF.
q_en: How should this report be delivered?
options: 明细用分页 GET(cursor)从 task 表拉；CSV/PDF 走异步导出到 S3 给下载链接；且报告在 job 完成时生成一次
一次性把几万条明细全塞进一个响应返回
每次 UI 请求就重新现算一份 CSV
把报告塞进 job 状态接口的一个字段里返回
options_en: Paginate details with GET (cursor) from the task table; export CSV/PDF asynchronously to S3 with a download link; and generate the report once at job completion
Return all tens-of-thousands of rows in one response
Regenerate a fresh CSV on every UI request
Stuff the report into a field of the job-status endpoint
optionExplanations: 对：明细分页(cursor)拉、文件走异步导出到 S3 返回 URI、且在 job 完成时生成一次报告——UI 多次取也不重算。
错：几万条一次返回会撑爆响应。
错：每次请求现算=重复生成、浪费。
错：大报告塞进状态字段既臃肿又不该。
optionExplanations_en: Right: paginate details (cursor), export files asynchronously to S3 returning a URI, and generate the report once at job completion so repeated fetches do not recompute.
Wrong: returning tens of thousands of rows at once blows up the response.
Wrong: recomputing on every request wastes work.
Wrong: a big report does not belong in a status field.
why: 三层：①逐条明细用分页 GET(page_size+cursor)从 task 表拉；②要 CSV/PDF 就走异步导出作业→生成文件存 S3→返回下载 URI；③关键：报告在 job 完成时作为收尾阶段生成一次，UI 多次 GET 直接取现成的，不重复现算。
why_en: Three layers: (1) paginate per-message details via GET (page_size + cursor) from the task table; (2) for CSV/PDF, run an async export job → generate the file to S3 → return a download URI; (3) key: generate the report once as the job's final stage, so repeated UI GETs read the ready file instead of recomputing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用「上一页末尾的位置(cursor)」取下一页，适合大列表稳定翻页；比 offset 在数据变动时更稳
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cursor pagination fetches the next page from the last item's position — stable for large, changing lists, unlike offset.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大文件(CSV/PDF)不在请求里现生成，而是后台作业生成后存对象存储(S3)、返回下载链接
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Async export generates a large file (CSV/PDF) in a background job, stores it in object storage (S3), and returns a download link.

scenario: worker 从队列拿到一个「把 msg 移到目标文件夹」的任务。
scenario_en: A worker pulls a "move msg to destination folder" task from the queue.
q: 哪段代码正确地完成一次移动？
q_en: Which snippet correctly performs one move?
options: BEGIN; UPDATE message SET folder=? WHERE id=?; UPDATE task SET status=done WHERE id=?; COMMIT;
UPDATE message SET folder=? WHERE id=?;  然后另一个连接里 UPDATE task SET status=done;
UPDATE task SET status=done WHERE id=?;  -- 只标完成，不改文件夹
DELETE FROM message WHERE id=?;  -- 删掉而不是移动
options_en: BEGIN; UPDATE message SET folder=? WHERE id=?; UPDATE task SET status=done WHERE id=?; COMMIT;
UPDATE message SET folder=?; then in a separate connection UPDATE task SET status=done;
UPDATE task SET status=done WHERE id=?;  -- only mark done, do not change folder
DELETE FROM message WHERE id=?;  -- delete instead of move
optionExplanations: 对：改文件夹 + 标任务在同一事务，要么全成要么全回滚，不会半完成。
错：两次独立提交，崩在中间就状态不一致。
错：没真移动，只标了完成。
错：移动是改 folder，不是删除邮件。
optionExplanations_en: Right: folder change + task mark in one transaction — all or nothing, no half-done state.
Wrong: two independent commits leave inconsistency if it crashes between them.
Wrong: nothing is actually moved, only marked done.
Wrong: moving means changing the folder, not deleting the email.
why: 移动 = 改 message 的 folder + 把 task 标 done，放在同一个数据库事务里；两步要么都成、要么都回滚，杜绝「移了但没记 / 记了但没移」。
why_en: A move = change the message folder + mark the task done, in one DB transaction; both commit or both roll back, avoiding "moved but not recorded / recorded but not moved".

termDefinitions.meaning: BEGIN…COMMIT 包起来的一组写，具备原子性：全部成功或全部回滚，中间崩溃不留半成品
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transaction (BEGIN…COMMIT) groups writes atomically: all succeed or all roll back, so a crash leaves no half-done state.

scenario: 队列是 at-least-once：同一个移动任务可能被重投两次。
scenario_en: The queue is at-least-once: the same move task may be redelivered twice.
q: 哪段 worker 逻辑对「重复投递」是安全的？
q_en: Which worker logic is safe against duplicate delivery?
options:
if task.status==done: return   # 幂等：已做过就跳过
  with txn: move(msg); mark_done(task)
move(msg); mark_done(task)     # 不查状态，来一次做一次
for _ in range(3): move(msg)   # 保险起见移三遍
mark_done(task)                # 直接标完成，不移动
options_en:
if task.status==done: return   # idempotent: skip if already done
  with txn: move(msg); mark_done(task)
move(msg); mark_done(task)     # no status check, act on every delivery
for _ in range(3): move(msg)   # move three times to be safe
mark_done(task)                # just mark done, no move
optionExplanations: 对：先查状态、已完成就跳过，重投也无害（幂等）；否则在事务里移动+标完成。
错：不查状态，重投会把同一封重复处理。
错：故意移三遍更糟，纯属重复。
错：不移动只标完成，等于没干活。
optionExplanations_en: Right: check status first and skip if done (idempotent), so redelivery is harmless; otherwise move + mark done in a transaction.
Wrong: no check means redelivery reprocesses the same email.
Wrong: moving three times is deliberately worse.
Wrong: marking done without moving does no real work.
why: 队列 at-least-once → 任务会重投。worker 要幂等：先查任务状态，已 done 就直接返回；否则在事务里移动并标完成。这样重复投递不会重复移动。
why_en: An at-least-once queue redelivers tasks, so the worker must be idempotent: check the task status, return if already done; otherwise move and mark done in a transaction. Then duplicate delivery does not double-move.

termDefinitions.meaning: 队列的投递语义：保证不丢，但可能重复投递，所以消费者必须幂等
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An at-least-once queue never drops a message but may redeliver it, so consumers must be idempotent.

scenario: 几十个 worker 并发地把 job 的 processed_count 各自 +1。
scenario_en: Dozens of workers concurrently each increment the job processed_count by 1.
q: 哪种计数更新不会漏计（无并发竞态）？
q_en: Which counter update avoids lost increments (no race)?
options: UPDATE jobs SET processed_count = processed_count + 1 WHERE job_id=?   -- 或 Redis INCR
c = SELECT processed_count; c = c + 1; UPDATE jobs SET processed_count = c   -- 读改写
每个 worker 存自己的局部计数，永不合并
让前端每次轮询时自己重新数一遍
options_en: UPDATE jobs SET processed_count = processed_count + 1 WHERE job_id=?   -- or Redis INCR
c = SELECT processed_count; c = c + 1; UPDATE jobs SET processed_count = c   -- read-modify-write
Each worker keeps its own local count, never merged
Let the frontend re-count on every poll
optionExplanations: 对：在数据库里原地 +1（或 Redis INCR）是原子的，并发也不漏计。
错：读→加→写有窗口，两个 worker 同时读到同值就丢一次自增（lost update）。
错：局部计数永不合并，job 永远数不全。
错：前端重数是聚合压力，且不是权威计数。
optionExplanations_en: Right: an in-place +1 in the DB (or Redis INCR) is atomic and loses no increments under concurrency.
Wrong: read→add→write has a window; two workers reading the same value lose one increment (lost update).
Wrong: local counts never merged means the job is never fully counted.
Wrong: re-counting in the frontend is aggregation load and not authoritative.
why: 并发自增要原子：用 `SET x = x + 1` 这种数据库原地更新或 Redis `INCR`，一步完成。若「读出来→加一→写回去」，两个 worker 同时读到旧值就会覆盖彼此、漏计（lost update）。
why_en: Concurrent increments must be atomic: use an in-place `SET x = x + 1` DB update or Redis `INCR`, done in one step. A read→add→write instead lets two workers read the same old value and overwrite each other, losing an increment (lost update).

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个并发的「读-改-写」都基于同一旧值，后写的覆盖前写的，导致一次更新丢失
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lost update: two concurrent read-modify-write ops start from the same old value and one overwrites the other, losing an update.

scenario: 复盘这题的 API/设计层。
scenario_en: Reviewing this problem at the API/design level.
q: 下面哪些是这题常见的「设计」错误？（多选）
q_en: Which are common design-level mistakes here? (multi-select)
options: 同步 API：在请求里把几千封移完再返回
靠前端轮询顺便把 job 标成 completed
每次 UI 要报告就现算一份，不缓存
提供一个 GET 接口查 job 进度
options_en: A synchronous API that moves all thousands within the request
Relying on frontend polling to flip the job to completed
Recomputing the report on every UI request, uncached
Providing a GET endpoint to check job progress
optionExplanations: 错误：同步移几千封会阻塞、超时——该异步作业。
错误：完成判定放在服务端(processed==total)，不能等 UI 轮询来标。
错误：报告应在 job 完成时生成一次，UI 反复取现成的。
这是对的：查进度就该有个 GET 接口，不是错误。
optionExplanations_en: Mistake: moving thousands synchronously blocks and times out — should be an async job.
Mistake: completion is decided server-side (processed==total), not flipped by UI polling.
Mistake: the report should be generated once at completion and re-served, not recomputed.
This is correct: a GET progress endpoint is right, not a mistake.
why: 设计层三个坑：①同步移几千封(阻塞/超时)②靠前端轮询标完成(判定放错层)③每次请求现算报告(重复生成)。正解：异步作业 + 服务端判定完成 + 报告完成时生成一次。查进度的 GET 接口是对的。
why_en: Three design pitfalls: (1) moving thousands synchronously (blocks/times out); (2) relying on frontend polling to mark complete (wrong layer); (3) recomputing the report per request. Fix: async job + server-decided completion + report generated once. A GET progress endpoint is correct.

scenario: 复盘这题的服务端架构层。
scenario_en: Reviewing this problem at the server-architecture level.
q: 下面哪些是这题常见的「架构」错误？（多选）
q_en: Which are common architecture-level mistakes here? (multi-select)
options: 不要队列，服务在请求里同步循环几千次
把几千封打包成一条巨型消息，一个 worker 做完
让客户端直连数据库、自己发 SQL 移动
用 worker 池并行消费队列、逐条移动
options_en: No queue; the service loops thousands of times synchronously in the request
Pack all thousands into one giant message for a single worker
Let the client connect directly to the DB and issue SQL
Use a worker pool to consume the queue in parallel, moving one by one
optionExplanations: 错误：没队列的同步循环就是阻塞设计。
错误：巨型单消息=单点、无并行、失败全丢。
错误：客户端直连库是安全与耦合灾难。
这是对的：队列+worker 池并行消费才是正解。
optionExplanations_en: Mistake: a synchronous loop with no queue is the blocking design.
Mistake: one giant message is a single point, no parallelism, all-or-nothing failure.
Mistake: a client connecting directly to the DB is a security and coupling disaster.
This is correct: a queue + worker pool consuming in parallel is the right answer.
why: 架构层三个坑：①无队列同步循环(阻塞)②巨型单消息(单点/无并行/失败全丢)③客户端直连数据库(安全+耦合灾难)。正解：网关→服务→队列→worker 池并行消费、单条可重试。
why_en: Three architecture pitfalls: (1) synchronous loop with no queue (blocking); (2) one giant message (single point, no parallelism, all-or-nothing); (3) client connecting directly to the DB (security + coupling disaster). Fix: gateway → service → queue → worker pool consuming in parallel with per-item retry.

scenario: 复盘这题的数据模型层。
scenario_en: Reviewing this problem at the data-model level.
q: 下面哪些是这题常见的「数据模型」错误？（多选）
q_en: Which are common data-model-level mistakes here? (multi-select)
options: 不建 task 表，只靠 message 表的当前状态
task 表死绑 source/destination 文件夹，无法泛化
job 表没有 total_count，无法判定何时完成
用 task_type + payload 让任务模型通用
options_en: No task table, relying only on the message table current state
A task table hard-bound to source/destination folder, not generalizable
A job table with no total_count, so completion cannot be detected
Using task_type + payload to make the task model generic
optionExplanations: 错误：没 task 表就没有历史，无法审计「为什么这封在这个文件夹」。
错误：死绑移动字段就没法扩到批删除/归档等操作。
错误：没 total_count 就无法判断 processed==total，判不了完成。
这是对的：task_type + payload 正是让它通用的正解。
optionExplanations_en: Mistake: no task table means no history and no audit of "why is this email here".
Mistake: hard-bound move fields cannot extend to bulk delete/archive, etc.
Mistake: no total_count means you cannot check processed==total to detect completion.
This is correct: task_type + payload is exactly what makes it generic.
why: 数据模型层三个坑：①没 task 表(无历史/无法审计)②task 表死绑源/目标文件夹(不能泛化)③job 表缺 total_count(判不了完成)。正解：task 表做审计 + task_type/payload 泛化 + job 存 total_count。
why_en: Three data-model pitfalls: (1) no task table (no history/audit); (2) task table hard-bound to source/destination folder (not generalizable); (3) job table missing total_count (cannot detect completion). Fix: a task table for audit + task_type/payload for generality + total_count on the job.

scenario: 面试里被追问「这个接口该返回什么状态码」，要答得准。
scenario_en: In an interview you are asked what status code an endpoint should return, and you need it right.
q: 关于 HTTP 状态码，下面哪个说法正确？
q_en: Which statement about HTTP status codes is correct?
options: 401=未认证、403=有身份但无权限、202=异步已受理、429=被限流
2xx 表示客户端出错，4xx 表示请求成功，正好这样对应
404 表示服务器内部错误，500 表示请求的资源不存在
301 表示请求成功，500 表示重定向到新地址
options_en: 401 = unauthenticated, 403 = authenticated but not allowed, 202 = accepted (async), 429 = rate limited
2xx means the client erred and 4xx means success — exactly that mapping
404 means an internal server error and 500 means the resource does not exist
301 means the request succeeded and 500 means redirect to a new address
optionExplanations: 对：401 是没认证/没登录，403 是登录了但无权限；202 是异步已受理；429 是限流。
错：反了——2xx 是成功，4xx 才是客户端错误。
错：反了——404 是找不到资源，500 才是服务器内部错误。
错：301 是永久重定向、500 是服务器错误，都不是成功。
optionExplanations_en: Right: 401 is unauthenticated, 403 is authenticated-but-forbidden; 202 is accepted async; 429 is rate limited.
Wrong: reversed — 2xx is success, 4xx is the client error.
Wrong: reversed — 404 is not found, 500 is the internal server error.
Wrong: 301 is a permanent redirect and 500 is a server error; neither is success.
why: 四大组记牢：2xx 成功、3xx 重定向、4xx 客户端错、5xx 服务端错。面试高频区分：401(未认证)vs 403(无权限)、202(异步已受理)、429(限流)、502/503/504(网关坏响应/不可用/超时)。
why_en: Memorize four families: 2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client error, 5xx server error. High-frequency distinctions: 401 (unauthenticated) vs 403 (forbidden), 202 (accepted async), 429 (rate limited), 502/503/504 (bad gateway / unavailable / timeout).

rows: 200 OK · 201 Created · 202 Accepted(异步) · 204 No Content
301 永久 · 302 临时 · 304 未改(用缓存)
400 请求错 · 401 未认证 · 403 无权限 · 404 找不到 · 409 冲突 · 429 限流
500 内部错 · 502 网关坏响应 · 503 不可用 · 504 网关超时

termDefinitions.meaning: 401 Unauthorized=没认证(你没登录/身份没验证)；403 Forbidden=认证过了但没权限。口诀：401 不知道你是谁，403 知道你是谁但不让
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 401 Unauthorized = not authenticated (not logged in); 403 Forbidden = authenticated but not allowed. Mnemonic: 401 = who are you, 403 = I know you but no.

termDefinitions.meaning: 4xx=客户端的错(请求有问题，重发同样的还会错)；5xx=服务端的错(请求没问题，是服务器崩了，可重试)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 4xx = the client's fault (the request is bad; retrying the same fails); 5xx = the server's fault (the request was fine; the server broke, retry may help).

termDefinitions.meaning: 301 永久移动(改域名、永久换 URL——浏览器/搜索引擎会缓存并更新链接)；302 临时(维护页、登录跳转、短链——短链用 302 是为了每次点都回服务端计数、且目标可改)；304 未改(条件请求 If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since，没变就用本地缓存、不回 body 省流量)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 301 permanent (domain change / permanent URL move — browsers cache and update links); 302 temporary (maintenance, login redirect, URL shorteners — 302 so each click hits the server for counting and the target stays editable); 304 Not Modified (conditional GET; unchanged → use local cache, no body).

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求与资源当前状态冲突：①重复创建(注册一个已被占用的邮箱)②乐观并发版本不匹配(你要改，但别人先改了)③非法状态转换(取消一个已发货的订单)。请求本身合法，只是跟现状打架
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 409 Conflict: the request clashes with current state — duplicate create (registering a taken email), optimistic-concurrency version mismatch (someone updated it first), or an invalid state transition (cancelling an already-shipped order). The request is valid but conflicts with reality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 500=应用自己崩了(代码 bug/未捕获异常)；502=网关从上游拿到「坏响应」(上游崩了/返回垃圾)；503=服务暂时不可用(过载/维护，可 Retry-After)；504=网关等上游「超时」(上游太慢没回)。502 是上游答了但答坏了，504 是上游根本没按时答
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 500 = the app itself errored (bug/unhandled exception); 502 = a gateway got a bad response from upstream (upstream crashed/garbage); 503 = temporarily unavailable (overload/maintenance); 504 = a gateway timed out waiting for upstream. 502 = upstream answered badly; 504 = upstream did not answer in time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 状态码是给「客户端软件」按程序反应用的(5xx/429→退避重试、401→跳登录)、也给开发/运维 debug 定位哪层挂了；终端用户只看到 app 翻译后的友好提示(「稍后再试」)，不看原始码。500 vs 502 vs 504 的细分主要给运维排障
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Status codes are for client software to react programmatically (5xx/429 → back off & retry, 401 → re-auth) and for devs/ops to debug which layer failed; the end user sees a friendly translation. The fine 500/502/504 split is mainly for ops diagnosis.
